sources.use: Current museum opening, appointment, entry, and bag-check route
Long-term low-precipitation and large temperature-range context only
Documented rain monitoring, clearance, and temporary-closure process

generalizations: The three lanes are original LazyTravel decision envelopes, not official itineraries or timetables
River, museum, height, and slow-city labels reuse accepted chapter decisions without reproducing street or operator geometry
One anchor per day is an editorial capacity rule, not a universal speed or accessibility claim
The one-day river and museum branches are alternatives and never imply that both must fit
Fallbacks replace a whole branch and require their own opening, access, meal, weather, and return checks
A warning, closure, unsafe condition, or booked departure overrides the diagram

notes: The 1620 x 2280 source and compiled B6 page preserve all three day lanes, the one-day OR choice, whole-day fallbacks, conditions, and cut order without collision or clipping.
At a 390 px viewport the 760 px map stage pans independently at reviewed left, centre, and right positions; all primary labels and reading lines remain available without vertical clipping.
